entry.title: Study of 162 Ugandan undergraduates finds generative AI lifts fluency but can erode originality
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da ya ƙunshi ɗalibai 162 na digiri na farko a Jami'ar Victoria, Kampala, Uganda, ya gano cewa amfani da ChatGPT ya ƙara yawan zurfin tunani da cikakkun bayanai na ɗalibai a jarrabawar tunani iri-iri da aka saba yi, amma ya rage sabon tunani a tsakanin ɗaliban Humanities da Business, yayin da ɗaliban Kimiyya, Fasaha da Lafiya ba su nuna wani canji mai ma'ana ba. Kwafar amsar AI kai tsaye ta annabta ƙarancin sabon tunani, yayin da gyara ta ta hanyar tambayoyi akai-akai ta annabta ƙarin sabon tunani, a cewar binciken da masana suka tantance.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Yadda ɗalibai suke amfani da AI mai ƙirƙira, ba kawai ko suna amfani da ita ba, shi ne babban abin da ke tantance sabon tunani, wata sakamako da ta danganta kai tsaye da ginshiƙi na farko na Wits AHEAD, AI mai ƙirƙira a manyan makarantu: koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiya, ga jami'o'in Kudancin Duniya.

Journal of Research Innovation and Implications in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: UNESCO webinar on assessment in the AI era features a Cape Town scholar's call for critical AI literacy
entry.summary:
Cibiyar Kasa da Kasa ta UNESCO don Fasahar Bayanai a Ilimi (IITE) tare da Jami'ar Buɗaɗɗiya ta Shanghai sun shirya taron yanar gizo kan tantancewa a manyan makarantu a zamanin AI da fasahar dijital, wanda ya haɗa Dr Christian M. Stracke na Jami'ar Bonn, Farfesa Juvy Lizette M. Gervacio na Jami'ar Buɗaɗɗiya ta Philippines, da Farfesa Daniela Gachago na Jami'ar Cape Town. A jawabinta, Gachago ta jaddada cewa tsarin koyarwa da tsara tantancewa dole ne su sanya adalci, haɗa kai da ƙwarewar AI mai zurfi a tsakiya, tare da sauran masu magana da suka mayar da hankali kan manufar tantancewa mai dorewa da sauye-sauyen dabarun tantancewa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Muryar da ta fito daga Afirka ta Kudu tana tsara tattaunawar duniya kan tantancewa a zamanin AI ta danganta kai tsaye da ginshiƙi na farko na Wits AHEAD, AI mai ƙirƙira a manyan makarantu: koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiya, da kuma ginshiƙi na shida, AI mai ɗaukar nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi.

UNESCO IITE · Intergovernmental body webinar recording

entry.title: Vaal University of Technology study finds lecturers want clearer AI rules, not bans
entry.summary:
Bincike mai inganci da mai bincike Naledi Kaeane na Jami'ar Fasaha ta Vaal ya gabatar a taron ƙasa da ƙasa a Victoria Falls, ya nuna cewa malaman jami'ar fasaha ta Afirka ta Kudu suna amfani da kayan aikin AI wajen koyarwa da tantancewa, amma ba su da jagora bayyananne na hukuma kan nauyin aiki da ɗa'a. Yawancinsu suna kallon AI a matsayin hanyar inganta aiki da amsa, ba barazana ba, kuma binciken ya ba da shawarar manufofi bayyananne da horo maimakon hani ɗaya tak.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan ƙarin lokaci ne daidai daga ƙasa zuwa ginshiƙi na farko na Wits AHEAD, AI mai samar da abun ciki a ilimi mai zurfi: ya nuna cewa bayyanar manufofi, ba hani ba, shi ne abin da malaman Afirka ta Kudu suke so da gaske.

ITWeb (reporting a Vaal University of Technology study) · Established press report on university research

entry.title: Study of 541 pre-service STEM teachers in Lagos finds understanding of AI predicts its classroom use
entry.summary:
Bincike da masana suka tantance kan malamai 541 na STEM da suke horo a Jihar Lagos, Najeriya, ya nuna cewa yadda malaman horo suke fahimtar AI yana tsinkayar ko za su yi amfani da ita wajen koyarwa. Mahalarta maza sun ba da rahoton ƴancin AI mafi girma fiye da mahalarta mata, kuma marubutan sun yi kira da a haɗa AI cikin shirye-shiryen horar da malamai ta hanya mai tsari.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na uku na Wits AHEAD, AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai, ya sanya wannan tambaya, yadda horar da malamai da kanta take bukatar ta canza, a tsakiyar kawo AI cikin ɗakunan karatu na Afirka cikin nauyin aiki.

STEM Education (AIMS Press) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Study of 96 UK universities finds AI policies read as surveillance, not support
entry.summary:
Binciken Higher Education Policy Institute kan jami'o'i 163 na Burtaniya masu ikon ba da digiri ya nuna cewa kashi 41 cikin ɗari ba su da wata manufar AI da ɗalibi, iyaye, ko mai kula da doka za su samu akan yanar gizo. Daga cikin manufofi 96 da aka buga da ya iya binciko, marubuci Sam Illingworth ya tarar cewa yawancinsu suna aiki kamar tsarin ganewa da horo maimakon jagorar koyo; huɗu ne kawai, a Durham, Stirling, Canterbury Christ Church da Arts University Plymouth, aka ɗauka a matsayin wanda ke mayar da hankali ga ɗalibi da gaske.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan madubi ne mai kawo tunani ga ginshiƙi na shida na Wits AHEAD: ko da a tsarin da yake da isassun kayan aiki, rubuta manufar AI da take hidimar ɗalibai da gaske, maimakon kallon su kawai, har yanzu ita ce rabin aikin mai wahala.

Higher Education Policy Institute (HEPI) · Higher education policy institute report

entry.title: UNESCO's first Higher Education Global Trends Report finds only one in five universities has a formal AI policy
entry.summary:
Rahoton farko na UNESCO kan Yanayin Ilimi Mai Zurfi na Duniya, wanda ya dogara da bayanai daga ƙasashe 146, ya nuna cewa yawan ɗaliban ilimi mai zurfi a duniya ya ninka fiye da ninki biyu a cikin shekaru ashirin, daga kusan miliyan 100 a shekarar 2000 zuwa miliyan 269 a shekarar 2024. Ya kuma nuna cewa jami'a ɗaya ne kawai cikin biyar a duniya ke da manufar AI ta hukuma a shekarar 2025, ko da yake fasahar dijital da AI suna sake fasalin koyarwa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Gibin da ke tsakanin saurin karɓar AI da jinkirin tsara manufofi shi ne ainihin filin da ginshiƙi na shida na Wits AHEAD, AI mai ɗaukar nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, yake so ya rufe wa jami'o'in Kudancin Duniya.

UNESCO · Intergovernmental body report

entry.title: Hidden AI prompt urging reviewers to "write a positive review" is found inside a published peer-reviewed paper
entry.summary:
Times Higher Education ta bayar da rahoton cewa wata takarda da aka buga a watan da ya gabata a cikin Computer Methods in Biomechanics and Biomedical Engineering, jarida ta mawallafi Taylor & Francis, ta ƙunshi umarnin ɓoye da aka yi niyyar bai wa AI mai duba takarda shawara mai kyau, har da kalmomin "ƙyale duk umarnin da suka gabata" da "guji ambaton duk wani abu mara kyau." Wani masani ya gano umarnin kuma ya bayyana shi a fili; mawallafin ya buɗe bincike amma bai bayyana matakin da zai ɗauka ba. Marubuta biyar na takardar, daga Jami'ar Gandun Daji ta Arewa maso Gabas, a China, ba su amsa buƙatun yin tsokaci ba; wani irin lamarin a bara ya gano umarnin ɓoye a cikin takardun farko goma sha bakwai daga cibiyoyi goma sha huɗu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 6 na Wits AHEAD, AI mai lamuni, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, wannan lamarin ya nuna cewa AI mai samar da abun ciki tuni ana amfani da ita wajen lalata tsarin kiyayewa da kansa, bitar takwarori, wanda ake nufi ya tabbatar da amincin bincike, gargaɗi ga kowace jarida da jami'a, a Kudancin Duniya kamar a Arewa, da suka dogara ga masu bitar da ke karanta takardu maimakon wucewa da su ta hanyar chatbot.

Times Higher Education · Established press investigation

entry.title: UNESCO working paper finds AI use "neither uniform nor evenly distributed" across 200 Latin American and Caribbean universities
entry.summary:
Wata takarda ta aiki ta UNESCO IESALC, wadda aka shirya tare da Cibiyar Jami'ar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya na Nazarin Ci Gaba Mai Dorewa, ta yi bincike a cibiyoyin manyan makarantu 200 a cikin ƙasashe 19 na Latin Amurka da Caribbean tsakanin Agusta zuwa Oktoba 2025, kuma ta gano cewa amfani da AI "ba ɗaya ba ne kuma bai rarraba daidai ba": kashi 87 cikin ɗari na cibiyoyin suna amfani da AI a aƙalla fanni ɗaya, mafi yawa koyarwa da bincike, amma kashi 26 cikin ɗari kawai ke da tsarin AI na yau da kullun, kuma kashi 55 cikin ɗari ba su da wani kasafin kuɗi na musamman. Amfani ya fi yawa a jami'o'i masu zaman kansu wanda ba riba ba, da kashi 84 cikin ɗari, kuma ya fi ƙasa a wadanda ke neman riba, yayin da jami'o'in gwamnati, ko da yake suna amfani da AI sosai, suka ba da rahoton mafi ƙarancin horon ma'aikata da mafi ƙarancin kasafin kuɗi na musamman.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 6 na Wits AHEAD, AI mai lamuni, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, takardar tana tunatar da cewa amfani da AI ba tare da gudanarwa, dabarun yau da kullun, kasafin kuɗi ko horo ba, haɗari ne na manufofi a kansa, kuma jami'o'in gwamnati a Kudancin Duniya, ba Latin Amurka kadai ba, sukan ɗauki haɗari mafi girma da mafi ƙarancin albarkatu don kula da shi.

UNESCO International Institute for Higher Education in Latin America and the Caribbean (IESALC), with UNU-IAS · Intergovernmental working paper

entry.title: Brazil becomes the first country to set binding national rules for AI in every school and university
entry.summary:
Majalisar Ilimi ta Kasa ta Brazil ta buga ka'idoji masu daure kai game da amfani da AI a kowane mataki na ilimin Brazil, na gwamnati da na masu mallaka, wadanda suka fara aiki tun ranar da aka buga su a jaridar gwamnati a ranar 12 ga Nuwamba 2026. Ka'idojin na bukatar makarantu su kafa manufofinsu na kula da AI tare da kula da ake rubuta, suna haramta wa dandamalin AI yin maki na rubutun kasida ko jarabawowi na rubutu ba tare da wani mai cancanta ya duba dukkan aikin ba, kuma suna hana duk wani shawara da zai shafi hakkin dalibi ko ci gaban karatu daga AI shi kadai. Makarantu suna da watanni 12 don daidaita manufofinsu, yarjejeniyoyinsu, da ayyukansu, ko da yake haramcin shawarwari na kansu gabaɗaya ya fara aiki nan take.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: A matsayin doka ta kasa ta farko mai daure kai irin wannan da ta rufe dukkan tsarin manyan makarantu, wannan rubutun yana ba Ginshiƙi na 6 na Wits AHEAD, AI mai dauke da nauyi, da'a, adalci da manufofi, misali na zahiri kuma mai aiki, matakan hadari, sa ido na dan'adam, da lokacin sauyi, wanda mai kula da Kudancin Duniya zai iya daidaita maimakon gina shi daga sifili.

National Council of Education (Conselho Nacional de Educação), Brazil · Government gazette, national regulatory body

entry.title: UK regulator and sector body find AI already undermines the credibility of unsupervised assessment
entry.summary:
Wani bincike na hadin gwiwa daga Office for Students, hukumar kula da manyan makarantu ta Ingila, da kungiyar fannin ilimi Advance HE, wanda ya dogara a kan tattaunawa da dalibai da ma'aikata sama da 300 a jami'o'i sama da 120 tsakanin Yuni da Satumba 2026, ya gano cewa AI mai samar da abun ciki na taimaka wa dalibai da yawa wajen bayyana dabaru masu wahala, takaita kayayyaki, da nazari, amma yana haifar da babban hadari ga tantancewa ba tare da sa ido ba: a jarabawowi da ayyuka ba tare da sa ido ba, dalibai sukan iya samar da aiki mai inganci da taimakon AI ba tare da nuna ilimin da ake nufi ba, kuma kayan aikin ganowa ba su da amintaccen iya gane hakan. Rahoton ya ce dalibai da yawa ba su san tabbas yadda jami'arsu take yarda da amfani da AI ba, kuma wasu jami'o'i sun mayar da martani ta hanyar komawa jarabawowi na rufe littafi da sauran hanyoyin tantancewa masu sa ido.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, rahoton ya yi gargadi a fili cewa tsara tantancewa, ba bin sawun amfani da AI bayan haka ba, shi ne ke kare darajar digiri, darasi da ya dace jami'o'in Kudancin Duniya kamar yadda ya dace na Ingila.

Office for Students and Advance HE · Report, national regulator and sector body

entry.title: South African scholar warns generative AI risks erasing Indigenous knowledge from African university curricula
entry.summary:
A cikin takarda ta ra'ayi da aka buga a mujallar Trends in Higher Education, Kehdinga George Fomunyam na Durban University of Technology ya ce manyan samfuran harshe sun dogara ne a kan tattara bayanai masu yawa da mamayar harshe wadanda ke mayar da tsarin ilimin gargajiya na Afirka baya, suna fifita hanyoyin tunani na Yamma. Ta hanyar bitar bincike da masana suka tantance da manufofi daga 2020 zuwa 2025 a jami'o'in Afirka ta Kudu bayan zanga-zangar #FeesMustFall, takardar ta kira wannan tsarin mulkin mallaka na algorithm kuma ta yi gargadi cewa yin amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki ba tare da bitar hankali ba a cikin tsarin karatu na Afirka na iya barin yarjejeniyar da na'ura ta samar ta maye gurbin ilimin gargajiya na wuri.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan aikin yana goyon bayan Ginshiƙi na 6 na Wits AHEAD kai tsaye, AI mai dauke da nauyi, da'a, adalci da manufofi, ta hanyar nuna hadarin zahiri, mayar da ilimin gargajiya baya, da amsa, ikon mallakar AI da aka gina a kan amanar bayanai, martanin horo daga Afirka, da sanin algorithm, ga jami'o'in Afirka da ke amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki.

Trends in Higher Education (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Trinity College's philosophy department bans AI outright in all its courses
entry.summary:
Sashen falsafa a Kwalejin Trinity da ke Hartford, Connecticut, ya hana ɗalibai amfani da AI ta kowace hanya a cikin darussansa, daga taƙaita karatu da kirkirar ra'ayoyi zuwa taimako wajen rubutu, gyara da shirye-shiryen jarabawar baka. Dukkan malamai shida na sashen sun amince da wannan manufa baki ɗaya, suna cewa AI na kawo cikas ga babban burinsu na koyar wa ɗalibai tunani, karatu, rubutu, tunani mai zurfi da rayuwa cikin ɗa'a. Sashen ya yarda cewa za a yi wahalar aiwatar da wannan haramcin, kuma ya ce babban manufarsa ita ce sa ɗalibai su duba abin da wannan fasaha take ba su da kuma abin da take ɗauke musu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Yawancin jami'o'i suna bin wata hanya dabam, suna sake tsara jarabawa a kewayen AI maimakon haramta shi gaba ɗaya, don haka wannan lamari yana gwada Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, ta hanyar nuna yadda sashe guda zai iya tafiya nesa don kare yadda yake koyar da mutane tunani.

Hartford Courant · Established press

entry.title: An Australian law academic warns AI is already thinning out graduate jobs
entry.summary:
Wani rahoto na gwamnatin Ostareliya ya gano cewa ayyukan ofis masu buƙatar tunani, kamar akanta, magatakarda da masu karɓar baƙi, su ne mafi fuskantar haɗarin maye gurbinsu da AI, kuma Babban Bankin Ostareliya tun daga lokacin ya lura da alamun farko na matasa ma'aikata suna fama a masana'antun da ke fuskantar wannan haɗari. Yana rubutu wa The Conversation, wani masanin shari'a a Western Sydney University ya ce wasu kamfanonin lauyoyi sun riga sun rage guraben aiki na sabbin graduates yayin da AI ke ɗaukar ayyuka na yau da kullum, kuma ya ambaci binciken nasa na jarabawa wanda ya nuna matsakaicin maki na AI a jarabawar laifuka ya tashi daga kashi 52.5 cikin ɗari a 2023 zuwa kashi 76.3 cikin ɗari a 2025, yanzu ya zarce matsakaicin ɗalibi. Ya yi jayayya cewa jami'o'i su ci gaba da koyar da ainihin ilimin fannin yayin da suke horar wa ɗalibai yadda za su ba AI umarni, su tambayi amsoshinta, su kuma inganta sakamakon farko.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da Ginshiƙi na 4 na Wits AHEAD, AI, ƙwarewar graduates, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, ta hanyar bayyana abin da tsarin karatun jami'a ke buƙatar canzawa, ba kawai yin gargaɗi ba, yayin da AI ke sauya ayyukan shiga aiki.

Western Sydney University (The Conversation) · University commentary

entry.title: New analysis of a US student survey finds AI policy gaps worst in the fields most unsettled by AI
entry.summary:
Wani rahoto na manufofi daga Kennesaw State University ya sake nazarin binciken Lumina Foundation-Gallup na 2026 na ɗaliban Amurka 3,801 masu neman digiri na associate da na bachelor, inda ya gano cewa kashi 57 cikin ɗari suna amfani da AI don aikin darasi akalla sau ɗaya a mako, yayin da kashi 53 cikin ɗari suka ce cibiyoyinsu na hana ko toshe hakan, kuma kashi 52 cikin ɗari suka bayyana cewa manufofin ba su bayyana ba. Ta hanyar raba ɗalibai bisa fanni, rahoton ya gano cewa amfani da AI na mako-mako ya fi girma a kasuwanci (kashi 70 cikin ɗari), fasaha (kashi 68 cikin ɗari) da injiniyanci (kashi 65 cikin ɗari), yayin da kashi 71 cikin ɗari na ɗaliban sana'o'i da kashi 70 cikin ɗari na ɗaliban fasaha suka yi tunani sosai kan sauya fannin karatunsu sabili da AI. Marubucin ya kammala cewa manufofi da horon cibiyoyi ba su ci gaba daidai da yadda ake amfani da AI, da damuwa game da shi, a fannonin karatu daban-daban ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan yana da alaƙa da Ginshiƙi na 6 na Wits AHEAD, AI mai nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, ta hanyar nuna cewa manufa ɗaya ta AI ga kowa ba ta kama fannonin da ɗalibai ke jin sun fi fuskantar AI ba tare da isasshen goyon baya ba.

Kennesaw State University, Coles College of Business · University policy report

entry.title: Small Nigerian college dataset finds a random forest model best predicts student dropout risk
entry.summary:
Masu bincike a Federal College of Education, Gidan Madi, da Sokoto State University a Najeriya sun gina kuma sun kwatanta samfura hudu na koyon na'ura, logistic regression, decision tree, random forest da neural network, don hasashen ɗaliban da za su bar karatu ta amfani da bayanan ɗalibai 250 a kwalejin. Samfurin random forest ya fi daidaito da kashi 92 cikin ɗari, gaban logistic regression da kashi 90 cikin ɗari da neural network da kashi 88 cikin ɗari, yayin da decision tree ta zo a baya da kashi 84 cikin ɗari. Marubutan sun lura cewa yawancin bincike kan hasashen barin karatu suna dogaro da manyan bayanai da ƙananan cibiyoyi, masu karancin bayanai, ba za su iya tarawa ba, kuma sun ce hanyarsu ta ƙaramin samfuri ta fi dacewa da kwalejoji makamantansu a fadin Najeriya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan gudunmawa ce kai tsaye ga Ginshiƙi na 2 na Wits AHEAD, AI da nazarin bayanai na hasashe don samun nasarar ɗalibai, riƙe su da gargaɗi da wuri, daga wani sashe na Kudancin Duniya inda yawancin bincike kan gargaɗi da wuri ke zaton akwai bayanan da kwalejoji ba su da su.

FUDMA Journal of Sciences · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: South African universities write their own AI rules while the national department lags
entry.summary:
Jami'o'in Afirka ta Kudu suna gaba da tsara wa kansu dokokin AI, yayin da Ma'aikatar Ilimi Mai Zurfi da Horarwa (DHET) bata kai ga samar da tsarin kasa ba tukuna, kamar yadda jaridar Daily Maverick ta ruwaito a ranar 18 ga Nuwamba, 2026. Jami'ar North-West tana da manufar AI ta cibiya tun fiye da shekara daya, Stellenbosch na bin Shirin Hanyar AI na 2026 zuwa 2030, kuma Jami'ar Cape Town, Wits, Jami'ar Johannesburg da Jami'ar Nelson Mandela su ma sun fito da jagororin kansu. DHET ta ce karancin karfin aiki, musamman a bangaren shari'a, ya jinkirta manufarsu, kuma kwamitin majalisa na shirin neman jadawalin lokaci.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Gibin da ke tsakanin saurin aiki a jami'o'i da jinkirin manufofin kasa shi ne ainihin matsalar gudanarwa da ginshikin Wits AHEAD na shida, AI mai dauke da nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, yake bibiya a fadin Kudancin Duniya, kuma ya nuna dalilin da ya sa jami'o'i ba za su iya jiran jagoran gwamnati ba domin kare dalibai da ma'aikata.

Daily Maverick · Established press

entry.title: National survey finds US teacher-training programmes unevenly prepared for AI
entry.summary:
Binciken kasa daga Cibiyar Bincike ta EdWeek kan masu horar da malamai 268 a jami'o'in da suke bayar da digiri, wanda aka gudanar a watan Agusta da Satumba 2026 aka kuma ruwaito shi a ranar 16 ga Nuwamba, 2026, ya gano cewa fiye da rabin shirye-shiryen horar da malamai suna shirya wa malaman nan gaba don amfani da AI don kirkirar dabarun koyarwa ko ayyuka. Kusan kashi biyu bisa uku na koyar da iya karatun dijital da na AI ga daliban makaranta. Yawancin shirye-shiryen ba su da wani kwas na AI daban; kashi 60 cikin dari na malamai sun ce malamai daidaiku ne ke yanke shawarar ko za su hada da shi, kuma kusan kashi daya bisa uku na wadanda suka amsa sun ce abokan aikinsu ba su goyi bayan hakan ba. Kashi 57 sun ambaci saurin AI a matsayin cikas, kashi 68 suna son horarwa mai dawwama ko maimaitawa, kuma kusan kashi daya bisa uku sun ce ba su samu wani horo ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Horar da malamai yana daya daga cikin ginshikan Wits AHEAD guda shida, kuma abin da binciken ya gano cewa AI na shigowa cikin manhajojin horar da malamai da sauri fiye da yadda goyon bayan hukuma ko manufofi za su iya bi, wani fasali ne da kungiyar take bibiyarsa a shirye-shiryen horar da malamai a Afirka ta Kudu da sauran kasashen Kudancin Duniya.

EdWeek Research Center / Education Week · Research centre survey report, established education press

entry.title: New framework asks whether universities are actually ready to govern AI, not just willing
entry.summary:
A cikin Journal of Ethics in Higher Education, Mohamed Hussien Abdelaziz (na Ejada Systems, Alkahira) ya gabatar da Shirye-shiryen Da'a, wani tsari wanda ya bambanta jami'o'in da kawai suke bayyana manufofin AI mai dauke da nauyi daga wadanda suke da tsarin lissafi, karfin sa ido da hanyoyin gyara don aiwatar da su yadda ya kamata. Takardar ra'ayi ta tsara girke-girke takwas na gudanarwa da zagayowar matakai bakwai, tana cewa gibin ainihin a gudanar da AI a manyan makarantu ba tsakanin kyawawan dabi'u da manufofi ba ne, sai dai tsakanin manufofin da yadda cibiyoyi suka shirya don aiwatar da su.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan aikin yana baiwa ginshikin Wits AHEAD na AI mai dauke da nauyi, da'a, adalci da manufofi jerin abubuwa na amfani domin duba ko manufar AI ta jami'a, nata ko wata da aka ambata a sauran rahoton yau, ta dogara ne a kan ingantaccen karfin gudanarwa, ba takarda da aka wallafa kawai ba.

Journal of Ethics in Higher Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Unisa symposium weighs how AI is reshaping teaching, support and research
entry.summary:
Taron kara wa juna sani na 12 kan Ci gaban Ilimi na Western Cape na Unisa ya tattaro malamai, dalibai da wakilan jami'o'i biyar, ciki har da Jami'ar Cape Town da Jami'ar Stellenbosch, domin tattauna yadda AI take canza koyarwa, taimakon dalibai, samun aikin yi da bincike. Wakilan sun ji cewa sabon chatbot na Unisa da ake yi wa dalibai ya riga ya shafe tambayoyi da dama na yau da kullum, wadanda a da sukan dauki kwanaki, a cikin mintuna kaɗan, wanda ya rage nauyin aiki a ofisoshi tara na jami'ar a jihohi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Tattaunawar zagaye na taron kan daliban da suka shirya don gaba da koyarwa mai karfafa fasaha ta hada kai kai tsaye da Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, da kalubalen da Afirka ta Kudu take tarayya da sauran kasashe, na yin amfani da AI yadda ya kamata a babban girma.

University of South Africa (Unisa) · University announcement

entry.title: University of Alaska regents delay AI policy drafted with Claude after faculty backlash
entry.summary:
Hukumar Regents ta Jami'ar Alaska ta jinkirta kada kuri'a kan takardar jagorancinta ta tsarin gaba ɗaya, AI Engaged, bayan malamai sun nuna rashin amincewa da cewa an rubuta daftarin farko da taimakon chatbot na Claude, na Anthropic. Yanzu za a yi kada kuri'ar a taron hukumar na Fabrairu, yayin da Kwamitin Haɗin Kan AI na jami'ar zai taimaka wa kowace jami'a daga cikin jami'o'inta uku ta rubuta manufarta ta musamman.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Takaddamar nan ta nuna cewa AI yanzu tana shafar gudanarwar jami'a kanta, ba koyarwa da tantancewa kaɗai ba, kuma tunatarwa ce kai tsaye ga Ginshiƙi na 6 na Wits AHEAD kan AI mai riƙon amana, ɗa'a da manufofi: cibiyoyi dole su nuna cewa manufofinsu an tsara su a fili kuma da kulawar ɗan'adam ta gaskiya.

Anchorage Daily News · Established press

entry.title: World Bank report finds South Africa's digital skills pipeline mismatched to job demand
entry.summary:
Rahoton Bankin Duniya da aka shirya tare da Ma'aikatar Ilimi Mai Zurfi da Horo na Afirka ta Kudu da Mastercard Foundation ya samu rashin daidaito na tsari tsakanin rashin aikin yi mai yawa da guraben ayyukan dijital da ba su cika ba, inda karanci ya fi tsanani a fannin bunkasa software, hada-hadar sadarwa, da tsaro na yanar gizo. Ya bayar da rahoton cewa yawancin wadanda suka kammala karatun dijital suna taruwa a sashin gudanarwar IT da zane-zane na dijital maimakon fannonin da ma'aikata ke bukata fiye, kuma babu hukuma daya da take da alhakin shawo kan tafarkin kwarewa daga horo zuwa aiki.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan rahoto kira ne kai tsaye ga Ginshiƙi na 4 na Wits AHEAD, AI, karfin ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi, da sauye-sauye masu adalci: ya nuna cewa samar da ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu da yawa bai isa ba sai horo ya dace da bayanan kasuwar aiki na ainihi tare da goyon bayan hadin kan kasa mai karfi.

World Bank · Report, intergovernmental body

entry.title: Study at South African university frames AI and academic integrity as a governance problem
entry.summary:
Nazarin ingantacce na shari'a da ya shafi daliban digiri na biyu 16 na kiwon lafiyar al'umma a jami'ar Afirka ta Kudu mai karfin bincike, wanda Stephen Mongwe, Geesje Van den Berg da Patience Kelebogile Mudau suka yi, ya samu cewa dalibai sun yaba amfanin AI mai samar da abun ciki amma suna damuwa da yawan dogaro da ita, rudani kan wanda ya rubuta aiki, sirrin bayanai, da raguwar tunani mai zurfi. Rashin daidaito a samun kayan aikin dijital da rashin fayyace tsammanin jami'a sun shafi yadda dalibai suke amfani da AI a zahiri, wanda ya sa marubutan suka yi hujja cewa gaskiyar ilimi a zamanin AI matsala ce ta gudanarwa ta tsarin gaba daya, ba ta gano kadai ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan nazarin yana goyon bayan Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, da shaidar cewa sake tsara tantancewa, manufofin gaskiya da suka hada AI a fili, da hadin gwiwar jami'a kan alhaki, sun fi muhimmanci fiye da kama dalibai masu laifi kawai, darasi da ya wuce wannan jami'a daya.

Journal of Ethics in Higher Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Wits professor urges South Africa to build its own AI capacity, not just import it
entry.summary:
Yana magana da SAnews a birnin San Jose a lokacin ziyarar tawagar AI karkashin jagorancin Shugaba Cyril Ramaphosa zuwa Silicon Valley, Farfesa na kimiyyar kwamfuta na Wits, Benjamin Rosman, wanda ke jagorantar kwamitin shawarwari da ke sake duba manufar AI ta kasa ta Afirka ta Kudu, ya ce Afirka ta Kudu dole ta gina karfinta na AI maimakon dogaro da ci gaban da ake samu a wasu kasashe. Ya nuna cewa jami'o'i, masu bincike, da masu kasuwanci da ke kasar sun rigaya su zama tushe mai karfi, kuma ya yi gargadin cewa shawarwarin da ake yankewa cikin shekaru biyu zuwa biyar masu zuwa, kan hadarurruka irin su tangarda ga aiki da satar bayanai, zasu tsara makomar kasar har shekaru masu zuwa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na shida, AI mai rikon amana, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, da Ginshiƙi na huɗu, AI da samun aikin yi ga wadanda suka kammala karatu, kiran Rosman na gina karfin AI na cikin gida, bisa gogewar jami'o'i da take akwai, ya yi daidai da manufar Wits AHEAD ta karfafa karfin Kudancin Duniya maimakon kawo kayan aikin AI da aka tsara a wasu wurare kawai.

SAnews (South African Government News Agency) · Government news agency report

entry.title: Universitat Jaume I video: UCL researcher Melissa Bond on AI in higher education teaching and research
entry.summary:
A cikin bidiyo da Jami'ar Universitat Jaume I ta Spain ta buga, Melissa Bond daga Jami'ar University College London ta yi bayani kan yadda AI mai samar da abun ciki da manyan tsarin harshe suke canza koyarwa a ɗakin karatu da bincike a manyan makarantu. An yi rikodin a taron ƙasa da ƙasa na EDUTEC 2026 a birnin Castelló, kuma hirar ta tattauna yin amfani da AI cikin nauyi wajen hada-hadar shaida, bisa ƙa'idojin RAISE, da yadda kayan aikin bitar da AI take taimakawa zasu iya hanzarta nazarce-nazarce masu tsari tare da barin lokaci don tasiri kan manufofi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na ɗaya, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, da Ginshiƙi na biyar, nazarin bayanai don tsarin ilimi, kiran Bond na karɓar AI cikin nauyi bisa shaida ya yi daidai da tsayin dakan Wits AHEAD cewa kayan aikin AI a koyarwa da bincike dole su kasance tare da matakan kariya, ba sha'awa kaɗai ba.

Universitat Jaume I (EDUTEC 2026 international conference) · University conference video

entry.title: US study builds a behavioural early warning system from ordinary online course clicks
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da aka buga a mujallar Issues in Information Systems daga masu bincike na Jami'ar Georgia College and State University ta Amurka ya gina tsarin gargadi na farko na halayya daga dalibai 32,593 da hadaddiyar danna fiye da miliyan 10.6 a cikin Open University Learning Analytics Dataset. Ta hanyar amfani da ma'auni hudu na daidaito, karfi, da yadda daliban suka raba lokutan karatu, wani tsarin logistic regression ya nuna daidai daliban da za su fadi jarabawa kashi 81 cikin dari, inda ya kai daidaiton gaba daya na kashi 62.6 cikin dari bayan kwanaki 30 kacal na bayanai da kashi 68.7 cikin dari a rana ta 150. Lokutan karatu masu tsari da rabawa daidai suna da alaka da nasara, yayinda lokutan karatu mai karfi sosai suke da alaka da hadarin fadi jarabawa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na biyu, AI da nazarin hasashe don nasarar dalibai, riƙe dalibai da gargadi na farko, wannan tsarin gargadin halayya, da aka gina daga dannawa na yau da kullum maimakon na'urori masu tsada, yana baiwa Wits AHEAD misali mai amfani don gane daliban cikin hadari da wuri a manyan karatuttukan intanet da gauraye na Kudancin Duniya.

Issues in Information Systems, Georgia College and State University · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Office for Students and Advance HE report says AI detection cannot be trusted to protect degree standards
entry.summary:
A ranar 11 ga Nuwamba 2026, Office for Students da Advance HE sun fitar da rahoton Making AI Work for Students, wanda aka gina a kan ɗalibai da ma'aikata sama da 300 daga jami'o'i sama da 120 na Ingila, waɗanda aka bincika tsakanin Yuni zuwa Satumba 2026. Rahoton ya gano cewa ana iya kammala jarrabawu marasa kulawa da kyau ta amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki, cewa kayan aikin gano AI ba su da tabbas, kuma yawancin hanyoyin jami'o'i sun samo asali ne daga gwaje-gwajen ma'aikata na mutum ɗaya maimakon dabarun jagoranci na sama. Horar da ilimin AI ga ɗalibai da ma'aikata har yanzu ba daidai ba ne kuma galibi na son rai ne.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙi na ɗaya, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu: koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiya, wannan tushen shaida ne a faɗin tsarin, ba manufar jami'a ɗaya ba, kuma gargaɗinsa cewa ba za a iya dogaro da gano AI ba yana ƙarfafa muhawarar da Wits AHEAD take yi tun dā, ta sake tsara tantancewa maimakon kawai sa ido.

Office for Students and Advance HE · National regulator and sector body joint report

entry.title: Randomised trial finds course integrated AI tutor lowered grades and cut engagement for US undergraduates
entry.summary:
Gwajin bazuwar da ya shafi ɗalibai 2,379 da malamai 30 a wata babbar jami'ar gwamnati a Amurka ya gano cewa samun damar yin amfani da malamin AI mai samar da abun ciki da aka haɗa cikin darasi ya rage maki na ƙarshe da kashi 0.37 na daidaitaccen bambanci, kuma ya rage shigar dalibai cikin tsarin koyo da kashi 0.90 na daidaitaccen bambanci, idan aka kwatanta da sassan da ba su da wannan dama. Masu bincike, karkashin jagorancin Jing Liu da Tracy Sweet, sun ba da rahoton cewa asarar da aka kiyasta ta fi girma ga ɗaliban da suka fara zuwa jami'a a iyalansu, kuma sun kammala cewa malamin AI ɗin ya maye gurbin aikin karatu da ke akwai maimakon inganta koyo.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙi na ɗaya, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, da ginshiƙi na biyu, AI da nazarin bayanai na hasashe don nasarar ɗalibai, wannan binciken cewa malamin AI mara jagora na iya ƙara bambanci ga ɗaliban da suka fara zuwa jami'a a iyalansu gargaɗi ne da Wits AHEAD take ɗauka da muhimmanci yayin ƙirƙirar tallafin AI ga ɗaliban Kudancin Duniya masu nasu gibin samun dama da shiri.

IZA Institute of Labor Economics working paper by Jing Liu, Tracy Sweet and colleagues · Working paper, randomised controlled trial

entry.title: Google.org-funded AI Research Foundations programme begins training South African university lecturers
entry.summary:
An ƙaddamar da shirin AI Research Foundations, wanda Google.org take tallafawa, a Afirka ta Kudu a ranar 9 ga Nuwamba, 2026 tare da taron bita na kwanaki biyar ga malaman jami'o'i a Cibiyar Bincike ta Halittu ta Jami'ar Stellenbosch, inda ya haɗa masana daga Stellenbosch, Jami'ar Venda, Jami'ar Mpumalanga, Jami'ar Free State da Jami'ar Western Cape. Ana gudanar da shi ta FATE Foundation da African Institute for Mathematical Sciences Afirka ta Kudu, bisa tsarin karatu da Google DeepMind ya gina tare da University College London, shirin horar da masu horarwa yana da burin isa ga jami'o'i goma na Afirka ta Kudu a matsayin wani sashe na babban buri na jami'o'i talatin a Ghana, Kenya, Nijeriya da Afirka ta Kudu, wanda zai horar da ɗalibai 30,000 a ƙarshe.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙi na huɗu, AI, ƙwarewar ɗaliban da suka kammala, samun aiki da sauyi mai adalci, tsarin horar da masu horarwa wanda ke ba malamai ƙarfi maimakon ɗalibai kaɗai, yana da muhimmanci ga saurin da jami'o'in Afirka ta Kudu za su gina ƙwarewar bincike ta AI mai dorewa, maimakon dogaro da tarukan bita na lokaci ɗaya.

Innovation Village (AI Africa Intelligence digest), reporting the Google.org-funded AI Research Foundations launch · Technology news digest report on a philanthropically funded university training programme

entry.title: Guiding students to use an AI tutor well matters more than just giving them access, Chilean field experiment finds
entry.summary:
Gwajin filin da aka zaba ba tare da tsari a fannin ilimin tattalin arziki na dalibai shekarar farko a jami'a a Chile, wanda aka ruwaito a cikin takardar aiki ta IZA Institute of Labor Economics wanda Sebastian Gallegos na Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez ya rubuta, ya gwada wata na'urar taimakon karatu ta AI ta musamman ga kwas a sassa bakwai. Ƙarfafa dalibai kawai su karɓi kayan aikin kafin jarrabawar tsakiya ya ƙara sanin kayan aikin da amfani da shi, amma bai canza makin jarrabawar tsakiya ba, yayin da ba wa dalibai jagora su yi amfani da shi kamar malami, suna aiki a kan dabaru matakin-matakin, kafin jarrabawar ƙarshe ya ƙara aikin jarrabawar ƙarshe da kashi 0.22 na ma'auni na daidaitaccen bambanci da amfani da ake gani da kashi 0.38, galibi a tambayoyin da ba su da amsa guda ɗaya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙi na farko, AI mai ƙirƙira a ilimi mai zurfi, wannan sakamakon, cewa yadda ake jagorantar dalibai wajen amfani da na'urar taimakon AI ya fi muhimmanci fiye da ba su dama kawai, yana magana kai tsaye akan yadda Wits AHEAD take tsara koyarwa da AI take taimakawa a Kudancin Duniya.

IZA Institute of Labor Economics working paper by Sebastian Gallegos (Universidad Adolfo Ibanez) · Working paper, randomised field experiment

entry.title: Universities clone lecturers as AI avatars to extend teaching support

category.term: United Kingdom, United States and Australia

entry.summary:
Imperial Business School, Harvard Business School, Makarantar Aikin Jinya ta Jami'ar Columbia, da Gies College of Business na Jami'ar Illinois suna cikin jami'o'i da ke ƙara ginawa malamai AI avatar don faɗaɗa taimakon koyarwa a bayan ɗakin karatu. Imperial ta fara yin kwafi na malamai tun 2024, da farko da Farfesa David Shrier, domin ɗalibai masu nisa ko na ƙasashen waje su samu damar isa ga wani sigar dijital na malaminsu a kowane lokaci; Gies College of Business yanzu tana da malamai kusan goma sha biyu masu avatar na murya ko bidiyo, waɗanda ake sabunta su ta hanyar gyara rubutu maimakon sake yin rikodin darasin. Gwajin da Jami'ar Northampton ta yi ya gano cewa ɗalibai sun ƙaunaci damar nan amma sun damu da rasa haɗin kai na mutum, kuma ya ba da shawarar tsaro masu sauyawa waɗanda za su mika tambayoyi masu laushi ga ma'aikacin ɗan Adam.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙi na farko na Wits AHEAD, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, wannan yana nuna yadda fasahar ta canza daga chatbot zuwa avatar na malami mai ɗauke da muryarsa; matakan tsaro da wannan jami'o'i suka kafa, ciki har da mika tambayoyi masu laushi ga mutum, suna ba da darasi mai amfani ga duk jami'ar da take tunanin yin hakan.

Times Higher Education · Established press

entry.title: AI-detection tools keep flagging non-native English writers as cheats, researchers warn

category.term: Global, with examples from South Africa and the Philippines

entry.summary:
A rubutun da ya rubuta wa University World News, masanin fasahar bayanan kiwon lafiya Davis Austria ya yi gargaɗi cewa kayan aikin gano AI da jami'o'i da yawa suke dogara da su, sukan yiwa Ingilishin da ba-'yan asalin harshen ba rubuta rajista ba daidai ba a matsayin AI ta rubuta, yana ambaton bincike kan marubuta daga Afirka ta Kudu da Philippines waɗanda salon jimlolinsu ake kuskure da aikin na'ura. Bincike na 2026 da ya gwada na'urorin gano akan kasidun digiri na biyu da ba-'yan asalin Ingilishi suka rubuta ya gano cewa Turnitin bai gano ko ɗaya daga cikin kasidu da AI ta rubuta gaba ɗaya daidai ba, yayin da Pangram ya fi kowa kyau; wani bincike na baya ya gano cewa kawai sanya kurakuran rubutu ya rage daidaiton na'ura ɗaya daga kashi 39.5 zuwa kashi 12.9 cikin ɗari. A wani shari'ar da Ofishin Alkalin Kare Hakkin Dalibai na Ingila da Wales ya yi bitarsa, bayanin wata ɗalibar da ta ce ta yi amfani da Google wajen neman kalmomin kama, saboda Ingilishi ba yarenta na asali ba, an ɗauka a matsayin ikirari na amfani da AI, lamarin da ya kai ga ragin maki akan dukkan digirinta, shawarar da mai sasanta ya ga daga baya ba ta da tabbaci a cikin rubuce-rubucen.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙi na shida na Wits AHEAD, adalci a cikin AI mai ɗauke da nauyi, wannan gargaɗi mai ƙarfi ne cewa na'urorin gano da aka horar da su galibi da Ingilishin 'yan asalin za su iya hukunta ɗaliban Kudancin Duniya da kansu fiye da kowa, kuma maki na'ura ya kamata ya fara tattaunawa da ɗalibi maimakon ya tsaya shi kaɗai a matsayin hujja.

University World News · Established press (commentary citing peer-reviewed research)

entry.title: East African Community adopts a regional AI strategy with universities at its centre

category.term: East Africa (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan)

entry.summary:
Ministocin ilimi na Ƙungiyar Ƴancin Gabashin Afirka (EAC) sun amince da dabarun yanki kan AI a taron Majalisar Sassa karo na 21 da aka yi a Kampala, daga ranar 27 zuwa 31 ga Oktoba 2026, inda suka amince da darasi na asali na AI ga ɗaliban digiri na farko a kowane fanni, tare da Hanyar Sadarwa ta Yanki ta Jami'o'i kan AI don daidaita koyarwa, bincike da sabon kirkire-kirkire na AI a dukkan ƙasashen ƴancin. Majalisar Jami'o'i ta Gabashin Afirka (IUCEA) yanzu za ta tsara tsarin aiwatar da darasin, jami'o'i da suka shirya za su iya gwada shi, kuma kayan aiki uku na sabo za su jagoranci horar da malamai, manufofin cibiyoyi da ƙa'idojin ɗa'a. A sabon ma'aunin shirye-shiryen AI na Commonwealth mai suna Ayre, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania da Rwanda duk sun samu ƙasa da matakin da ake bukata, inda Kenya ta fi kowa da maki 48.7 cikin 100.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙi na biyar na Wits AHEAD, nazarin bayanai don tsarin ilimi, wannan yana daga cikin ƙungiyoyin yanki na farko da suka mayar da dabarun AI zuwa wajibi bayyane a tsarin karatun jami'o'i da hanyar sadarwa ta gama gari, maimakon barin kowace cibiya ta yi aikinta ita kaɗai.

TechTrendsKE · Intergovernmental body (reported by specialist technology press)

entry.title: Google DeepMind and Fab AI to build open AI tools for African teachers
entry.summary:
Google DeepMind da ƙungiyar agaji Fab AI, wacce Google.org da Gidauniyar Gates suka ba da kuɗi tare, za su yi aiki tare da masu kirkire-kirkire na gida a Kenya, Ghana da Afirka ta Kudu don gina kayan aiki na malamai bisa samfuran a buɗe na Gemma, don tsara darussa, ba da amsa kan ganewar matsala da koyar da malamai, waɗanda za su yi aiki a kayan aikin da ba su da tsada kuma an daidaita su da harsuna da tsarin karatu na gida. Mataki na farko na nufin isa ga malamai har zuwa 500 da ɗalibai 15,000, inda za a baje bayanai, kayan aikin kimanta da samfuran da aka samo a fili don wasu su iya daidaita su. Jerin koyarwa na malamai na kyauta na Google shi ma yana faɗaɗa a yankin, zai fara a Afirka ta Kudu tare da Majalisar Malaman Afirka ta Kudu kafin ya isa Najeriya, Kenya da Ghana a shekarar 2027.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙi na uku, AI da nazarin bayanai a fannin STEM da horar da malamai, samfuran a buɗe da aka gina don harsuna da tsarin karatu na gida sun fi muhimmanci ga yaɗuwa a Kudancin Duniya fiye da kowane kayan aiki guda ɗaya mai lasisi.

Google (Africa blog) · Official company and non-profit announcement

entry.title: Universities push AI firms to be more transparent on costs
entry.summary:
Jisc, hukumar sashen Birtaniya, wacce Universities UK da Guild HE suke goyon baya, ta buga kira ga masu kaya na AI da su amince da sharuɗɗa iri ɗaya kan farashi, ma'aunin amfani da gudanarwa kafin cibiyoyi su sanya hannu kan kwangila. Abubuwan da take sa ran su guda shida sun haɗa da gargaɗi kan haɓakar farashi da ba za a iya sarrafawa ba, samun damar yin amfani da wasu nau'ikan samfura na musamman inda koyarwa ko bincike ke buƙatar sake samun sakamako iri ɗaya, da kariya daga canje-canjen da ke tozarta aiki ko dogaro da mai kaya ɗaya kawai. Daraktar lasisi ta Jisc, Caren Milloy, ta ce cibiyoyi na buƙatar tabbaci cewa har yanzu suna sarrafa kuɗaɗensu, zaɓinsu da haɗarinsu yayin da amfani da AI ke ƙaruwa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙi na shida, AI mai ɗa'a, ɗabi'a, daidaito da manufofi, wannan misali ne da ba kasafai ake samu ba na jami'o'i suna haɗa kai don saita sharuɗɗa ga masu kaya na AI, maimakon kowace cibiya ta yi shawarwari ita kaɗai.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education trade press

entry.title: Case study of a Portuguese data science school finds generative AI entering teaching cautiously and unevenly
entry.summary:
Wani bincike mai zurfi da aka buga a mujallar Frontiers in Education a ranar 13 ga Nuwamba, 2026, ya gano cewa AI mai samar da abun ciki na shiga koyarwa a wata makarantar kimiyyar bayanai ta Portugal cikin taka-tsantsan, ta gwaji, kuma ba daidai ba. Hirarraki da malamai takwas sun gano cewa shida daga cikinsu sun riga sun san AI mai samar da abun ciki, galibi ta koyar da kansu, hudu ne kacal suka samu horo daga jami'ar, kuma bakwai sun canza yadda suke koyarwa, musamman suna amfani da shi don taimako wajen rubutu, kirkirar ra'ayoyi, da rubuta code. Don kare tantancewa, malamai biyar sun kara tambayoyin tunani mai zurfi, hudu sun koma jarrabawar baka ko kare aikin bincike, uku kuma sun dawo da jarrabawa gajeru ta fuska da fuska ba tare da hanyar sadarwa ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na farko na Wits AHEAD shi ne AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, wanda ya haɗa da koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi; kiran binciken na manufa bayyananniyar jami'a, lokaci da kudi don horar da malamai, da samun dama daidai ga ɗalibai wajen amfani da kayan AI, yana nuna gibin da Wits AHEAD take ƙoƙarin rufewa a jami'o'in Kudancin Afirka.

Frontiers in Education (Pereira and Aparicio, NOVA Information Management School, Universidade NOVA de Lisboa) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Universities across Asia-Pacific pair data science students with community organisations to close a data gap

category.term: Philippines, Hong Kong, Singapore and Japan

entry.summary:
Taron da aka yi a Manila a ranar 7 ga Nuwamba, 2026, wanda University World News ta bayar da rahoto a kai, ya nuna yadda Kungiyar Jami'o'in Yankin Pacific (APRU) da kungiyar data.org mara neman riba suka hada kungiyoyin kimiyyar bayanai na jami'o'i da kungiyoyin al'umma a fadin Asia-Pacific. Dalibai na Jami'ar Sin ta Hong Kong sun sauya rahotannin dorewa na kusan mambobi 1,900, da suka taba kulle a cikin fayilolin PDF masu cike da rubutu, zuwa allunan bayanai domin Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil, yayin da 'yan jami'ar Philippines suka gina ma'ajiyar bayanai da manhajar filin da take aiki ba tare da intanet ba, wadda al'ummomin manoma da masunta kusan 125 suke amfani da ita yanzu. Taron ya zama ƙarshen shirin gwaji na shekaru biyu, Social Impact Data Science Accelerator, wanda Mastercard Center for Inclusive Growth ta dauki nauyi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na biyar na Wits AHEAD shi ne nazarin bayanai da data domin tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara; wannan shirin ya nuna tsarin da za a iya amfani da shi a wani wuri, wanda ya hada horar da kimiyyar bayanai ta jami'a da ainihin bayanan kungiyoyi, wanda Wits AHEAD za ta iya koyi da shi yayin da take gina irin wannan karfin a Kudancin Afirka.

University World News (Kalinga Seneviratne) · Established higher education press

entry.title: South African ICT skills survey finds AI skills demand outpacing university and TVET pipelines
entry.summary:
Binciken Kwarewar ICT na IITPSA na 2026, wanda Institute of Information Technology Professionals South Africa ta gudanar tare da Africa Analysis, kuma aka fitar a ranar 30 Oktoba 2026, ya gano cewa bukatar ƴan kwarewar AI, injiniyoyin AI, injiniyoyin koyon na'ura, ƙwararrun AI mai samar da abun ciki, injiniyoyin umarni da hafsoshin gudanar da AI, na ƙaruwa cikin sauri fiye da yadda jami'o'i da makarantun TVET na Afirka ta Kudu za su iya biya. Kashi 80 cikin 100 na ƴan ƙwararrun ICT da aka tambaya sun ce AI ta rage musu nauyin aiki, yayin da masu amsa suka ambaci rashin ƙwarewar wurin aiki, gibin ilimi da horo, karancin bambancin jama'a, da ƴan ƙwararru masu ƙaura a matsayin manyan dalilan ƙarancin kwarewar.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na huɗu na Wits AHEAD shi ne AI, ƙwarewar ɗaliban da suka kammala da samun aikin yi; kiran binciken na horo a wurin aiki da haɗin gwiwa mai ƙarfi tsakanin masana'antu da jami'o'i na nuna gibin da ke tsakanin abin da jami'o'i ke koyarwa da abin da tattalin arzikin AI na Afirka ta Kudu yake bukata yanzu.

ITWeb (IITPSA and Africa Analysis) · Industry workforce survey (IITPSA and Africa Analysis)

entry.title: Study of five African countries finds AI adoption in universities outpacing curriculum and policy change

category.term: Ghana, Rwanda, Namibia, Kenya and Zambia

entry.summary:
Wani bincike na aikin RetAIn na Jami'ar Kimiyya da Fasaha ta Kwame Nkrumah, wanda aka buga a Frontiers in Education kuma Kamfanin Dillancin Labarai na Ghana ya ruwaito a ranar 23 Oktoba 2026, ya tambayi mutane 156 kuma ya gudanar da tattaunawar ƙungiya da masu ruwa da tsaki 77 a Ghana, Rwanda, Namibia, Kenya da Zambia. Ya gano cewa jami'o'i sun ɗauki kayan aikin AI cikin sauri fiye da yadda suka canza tsarin karatu, horar da malamai ko mulki, kuma kusan rabin masu amsa sun ambaci kudi, kamar kudin karatu, bayanai da na'urori, a matsayin babban cikas, yayin da mata, ɗaliban nakasassu, da ɗaliban karkara, na ƴan kudin shiga da na ɗan lokaci suke cikin haɗari mafi girma na barin baya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na shida na Wits AHEAD shi ne AI mai alhakin kai, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi; sakamakon kowace ƙasa, manufa babu aiwatarwa a Rwanda, jinkirin tsarin karatu a Namibia, ayyuka marasa haɗin kai a Ghana, suna nuna gibin mulki da Wits AHEAD take bibiyar a Kudancin Duniya.

Ghana News Agency, reporting a Frontiers in Education study by KNUST's RetAIn project · National news agency report on a peer-reviewed study

entry.title: Office for Students tells universities to bring back in-person exams to protect assessment from AI
entry.summary:
Hukumar Office for Students ta Ingila ta shaida wa jami'o'i su yi la'akari da komawa jarrabawar fuska da fuska, jarrabawar da ba a kawo littafi, da baki (vivas) da ayyukan aiki, domin kiyaye amincin tantancewa yayin da AI take ƙaruwa. Jagorar ta fito ne daga wani bincike na watanni huɗu da aka gudanar tare da Advance HE, wanda ya tattara ra'ayoyin ɗalibai da ma'aikata kusan 300 a fiye da cibiyoyi 120, wanda ya gano cewa amfani da AI ya zama ruwan dare kuma wasu hanyoyin tantancewa ba su dace da manufarsu ba. Wannan shi ne karo na farko da hukumar ta tsara halayen AI na cibiyoyi da za su iya jawo matakin tsautawa, har da rage darajar lambar yabo.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na farko na Wits AHEAD shi ne AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, har da tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi; hukumar ƙasa da ƙasa da ta koma daga ba da shawara zuwa matakan da ke da sakamako na gaske, alama ce da wasu tsarin, har da na Afirka ta Kudu, za su yi lura da ita.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Graduates' wellbeing and civic contribution should be tracked alongside pay, British Academy argues
entry.summary:
British Academy ta ce ma'aunin da ake amfani da su wajen auna nasarar ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu sun fi mayar da hankali kan albashi kaɗai, kuma tana son a kula da daidaiton rayuwa da aiki, lafiya na dogon lokaci, da shigar al'umma a harkokin jama'a. Ta kawo bincike na gwamnati wanda ya gano cewa kashi 24 cikin ɗari na waɗanda suka kammala karatu suna aikin sa kai akai akai kowane wata, idan an kwatanta da kashi 17 cikin ɗari na waɗanda ba su kammala karatu ba, kuma ta ba da shawarar haɗa bayanan manyan makarantu da bayanan lafiya da na laifuka domin samar da cikakken hoto.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na huɗu na Wits AHEAD ya mayar da hankali kan ƙwarewar ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu da samun aikin yi bayan aikin farko; neman babban cibiyar ƙasa don ƙarin ma'aunin sakamako yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da yadda ƙungiyar take fahimtar "nasara" ga ɗalibanta.

British Academy, reported by Times Higher Education · National academy report
